description: This file defines dialog components and functions for creating, editing, and renaming tags and colors within the Notesnook project, including UI components and interactions with the database and state management.

classes.name: ItemDialog
classes.description: A dialog component for inputting a single string value, used for creating or editing tags and colors.

methods.name: ItemDialog
methods.description: A React component registered with DialogManager for displaying an input dialog.

methods.name: CreateTagDialog.show
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create a new tag, adds it to the database, and refreshes the tag store.

methods.name: EditTagDialog.show
methods.description: Displays a dialog to edit an existing tag, updates the database, and refreshes related stores.

methods.name: RenameColorDialog.show
methods.description: Displays a dialog to rename a color, updates the database, and refreshes navigation items.
